newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Fujimori to visit Southeast Asia.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Fujimori to visit Southeast Asia.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori will visit the Philippines, Thailand and Malaysia during an eight-day tour of South-East Asia this month, the Foreign Ministry said on Friday.
"The purpose of the president's visit is to foment Peru's economic links with South-East Asia through more trade and joint investments," the ministry said in a statement.

Fujimori, the son of Japanese immigrants, is a self-styled admirer of the Asian "tiger" nations and has based his free market reforms on a desire to transform the Peruvian economy along similar lines.
